newsitem.title: JAPAN: Wakachiku Construction bid-only in morning session.
newsitem.headline: Wakachiku Construction bid-only in morning session.

text.p: Wakachiku Construction Co Ltd was bid only in Friday morning trade, after speculative buying sent the shares limit-up on Thursday, brokers said.
As of 0134 GMT the shares were bid-only at 588 yen, after closing at 548 on the previous day.
The interest in Wakachiku shares was lifting other medium-sized firms in the construction sector, brokers said.
Sumitomo Construction Co Ltd was up 41 yen at 358 yen, the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse, and Saeki Kensetsu Kogyo Co Ltd was up 42 yen at 445 yen.
Arai-Gumi Ltd, Mitsui Construction Co Ltd and Fudo Construction Co Ltd were also higher.
